text:
Luca: quick heads-up — after the kernel-hint roll yesterday I'm seeing a consistent p99 latency bump on MQA configs for Mixtral + Llama variants. Throughput down ~12% on our 1k-concurrent synthetic workload.

Tara: can you paste the bench summary + which model/config you ran?

Luca: ran against mixtral-8x on dedicated-local (gpu-a100-80g). Snapshot: perf-dashboard/shot/2026-02-16/shot-7a3. Summary: avg throughput 5.2k tok/s -> 4.6k tok/s, p99 68ms -> 80ms, cpu steal small. Regression shows up only when rope_scale != 1.0 and num_key_value_heads is 8 or 16.

PerfBot: automatic profile attached -> link: https://perf.redwood/shot-7a3 (hot functions: attention_fused, kv_load_paged) :robot_face:

Jin: two hypotheses: 1) kernel selector falling back to generic attention when kv_dim parity + rope_scale changes cache alignment; 2) batching heuristic picks larger batch groups that trigger paged-KV hot-slab serialization.

Anya: I pulled a KV snapshot during the run — looks like heavy fragmentation on paged layout. Hot pages concentrated on a few slabs, causing repeated DMA churn. raw numbers: 72% of active entries live in 29% of pages, page eviction rate x2 baseline.

Luca: here's the exact config used:```yaml
model: mixtral-8x
num_key_value_heads: 16
kv_dim: 64
kv_layout: paged_interleaved
rope_scale: 1.15
kernel_hint: auto
batching: {max_batch_tokens: 4096, prefer_latency: false}
```

Tara: nice. If kernel_hint=auto we depend on runtime heuristics. Can you try kernel_hint: mqa_optimized_v2 and also a contiguous kv_layout as a quick A/B?

Jin: also try decreasing max_batch_tokens to 2048 and enable prefix-KV caching for repeated prompts. We saw a similar perf cliff when batcher coalesced many long sequences which amplified KV page thrash.

Anya: started two short runs: (A) kernel_hint=mqa_optimized_v2 + paged_interleaved, (B) kernel_hint=auto + kv_layout=contiguous. Running now, ETA ~ 7m.

PerfBot: run A baseline -> throughput 4.9k tok/s, p99 72ms. run B baseline -> throughput 5.4k tok/s, p99 66ms. Preliminary: contiguous layout recovers most throughput.

Luca: interesting — contiguous wins here. That suggests paged layout fragmentation + rope_scale shift breaks the heuristic that selects the optimized kernel. We should consider a fast check in kernel selector: if rope_scale != 1.0 and layout==paged_interleaved, prefer contiguous-optimized kernels or force a different load path.

Tara: agreed. Proposed immediate actions: 1) patch kernel selector to prefer mqa_optimized_v2 when num_key_value_heads % 8 == 0 and rope_scale != 1.0; 2) add a runtime metric: page_hot_ratio per model to the console; 3) temporary rollout: set default kv_layout to contiguous for mixtral-8x on Dedicated.

Jin: also add a micro-benchmark in the CI - generate intentionally skewed KV occupancy and assert eviction_rate < threshold. I can draft the test.

Anya: logging the artifacts and KV snapshots to perf-dashboard under ticket PERF-2041. I'll attach the page maps and a small viz showing slab skew.

Luca: thanks. I'll open the kernel-selector PR with a short unit test and we can gate the rollout behind canary. :thumbsup:
